News.title: Mykhailo Mudryk returns as Chelsea slip to Juventus defeat
News.content:
Chelsea 0 Juventus 1

Mykhailo Mudryk made his first Chelsea appearance since November 2024 as Xabi Alonso’s team succumbed to their second pre-season defeat.

Mudryk replaced Nicolas Jackson in the 82nd minute against Juventus, marking his return to competitive football after a long doping ban that was resolved this week thanks to changes in Wada regulations.

There were a couple of crosses delivered from the left flank by the Ukrainian winger, who could yet leave Chelsea on loan or on a permanent basis before the close of the transfer window.

Juventus were the victors though, thanks to a sumptuous 68th-minute goal by Kosovo winger Edon Zhegrova.

Alonso had 21 players on his bench, and made 12 second-half substitutions.

Levi Colwill and Cole Palmer featured in the defeat by 10-man Spurs on Saturday, but sat this game out as they continue to build fitness. Danny Welbeck did start though, reunited with former Brighton team-mate Joao Pedro up top.

Chelsea scored just one goal against Spurs and Juventus, but the thrust provided by right-back Marco Palestra in tandem with first Geovany Quenda and then Estevao was a bright spot for Alonso.

Chelsea continue their pre-season against AC Milan on Saturday, before they host Real Sociedad at Stamford Bridge on August 15.

They begin their Premier League campaign at Fulham in the Monday night slot on the opening weekend.

News.title: The underground lab where ‘princess mosquitoes’ are treated like royalty
News.content:
Beneath the grand Art Deco headquarters of the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine lies a vast labyrinth inhabited by weird and wonderful creatures.

In this maze of subterranean labs, store rooms and corridors live colonies of disease-bearing insects and arachnids from all over the world, from bed bugs, sand flies and microscopic dust mites to the so-called kissing bugs that spread Chagas disease – a sinister condition that can cause its victims to drop dead of heart failure without warning, albeit decades after the first (silent) infection.

Behind a series of doors, contained in stacks of mesh boxes, you can even find the flies that spread trachoma, the Dickensian eye disease that is still a leading cause of blindness around the world. But be warned: entering the room is not for the faint of heart – the flies feed on human excrement and the smell is impossible to forget.

There are also many varieties of mosquito, including several species of the Anopheles genus that spread malaria, Culex and Aedes mosquitoes that are also vectors for human and animal diseases, and even Toxorhynchites, perhaps better known as the elephant mosquito, a friendly giant which doesn’t bite people but preys on other mosquitoes.

These animals have been studied intensely since the insectaries were established in the building’s vaults in the 1960s, underpinning many breakthroughs in the control, surveillance, and understanding of vector-borne diseases in the developing world.

LSHTM researchers are now looking closer to home. They have established the UK’s first laboratory colony of Aedes vexans mosquitoes, a species native to the British isles, to study whether they could harbour diseases like West Nile virus, Rift Valley fever, Zika or Japanese encephalitis.

Sports.title: One of Ukraine’s largest stadiums bombed by Putin ‘missile’ on eve of top-flight match leaving hole in roof as 2 injured
Sports.content:
ARENA ATTACK One of Ukraine’s largest stadiums bombed by Putin ‘missile’ on eve of top-flight match leaving hole in roof as 2 injured

ONE of Ukraine’s largest sports stadiums has been blitzed by Putin on the eve of a top-flight match.

Russian forces struck in southern Ukraine today, August 7 at around 3pm, targeting Odessa’s Chornomorets Stadium, the largest arena in the south of the country.



The stadium, which can hold more than 34,000 fans, is home to both Chornomorets Odessa and Seasters.

The next game scheduled to be played there is August 8 between Chornomorets and Kolos, although this is now in doubt.



Ukrainian politician Oleksiy Honcharenko first reported the attack on his Telegram channel, showing footage from the impact site.

The blast damaged the arena’s load-bearing structures and blew out windows around the building’s perimeter, as well as damaging the stands.

A large hole was also made in the roof.

Head of the Odesa Regional Military Administration Oleh Kiper confirmed a 29-year-old woman sustained shrapnel wounds in the attack.



He said: “The injured woman is being provided with all necessary assistance.

“All relevant services are working at the scene.”

Although according to local media two people were injured.

Stadium director Serhiy Burka said that the injured were most likely employees of the club.

The explosion also caused dry grass to ignite on land next to the stadium but this was quickly dealt with by rescuers.



The Chornomorets Stadium is situated in Shevchenko Park in Odessa’s historic centre and regularly hosts Ukrainian Premier League matches.

Meanwhile, savage Russian forces carried out a sickening double-tap strike in the Zaporizhzhia region.

Two rescuers were wounded in the attack, according to the head of the regional military administration Ivan Fedorov.

A double tap strike a military tactic where the initial bombing, missile, or drone attack is followed intentionally by a second strike on the same location minutes later.

The secondary blast is intended to maximise casualties by hitting emergency crews and civilians who have rushed to the scene to help any rescue.



In the Zaporizhzhia strike, the second attack hit a fire truck as crews were attempting to put out a fire caused by the first hit.

An outbuilding of a private home was also damaged and subsequently caught fire.

Russian forces have repeatedly carried out double-tap strikes in the Zaporizhzhia region, reports claim.

On July 13, guided bombs initially struck residential areas in Zaporizhzhia which were then targeted a drone attack as police, rescuers and medics attended to the injured.

The Dnipropetrovsk region, in the south-east of the country was also targeted, with strikes killing two people and injuring six, according to the regional governor.



Oleksandr Hanzha, writing on Telegram, said Russian forces had launched nearly 50 attacks on five districts in the region, deploying drones, artillery and aerial bombs.

RECOMMENDED STORIES

Two people were killed near Nikopol, a frequent Russian target on the western bank of the Dnipro River, opposite the Russian-held Zaporizhzhia nuclear power plant.

One of the wounded was in a serious condition, Ganzha said.

Sports.title: Do Carabao Cup 1st round ties go to extra time or straight to penalties if it ends as a draw after 90 minutes?
Sports.content:
CLUB football returns with the first round of the Carabao Cup!

Sides from the Championship, League One and League Two will be looking to get their seasons off to a perfect start.



Some first round ties look too close to call and could still be level at the end of normal time.

If the match ends all square, the question at the front of everyone’s mind is whether there is extra time and penalties.



SunSport brings you all the information you need.

Do Carabao Cup 1st round ties go to extra time or straight to penalties if it ends as a draw after 90 minutes?

Carabao Cup first round ties go straight to penalties if the score is level after 90 minutes.

Ahead of the 2018/19 season, organisers scrapped extra time to reduce “additional fatigue issues” following a vote by English Football League clubs.

Extra time is used only in the Carabao Cup in the second leg of the semi-finals (if the aggregate score is level) and in the final.

What happened in last year’s Carabao Cup final?

Manchester City are the Carabao Cup holders after they beat Arsenal 2-0 in last year’s final.

Nico O’Reilly scored twice in four second-half minutes to fire his side to Wembley glory.



City’s triumph meant that Pep Guardiola became the first manager to win the League Cup five times.

The legendary gaffer left his post at the Etihad at the end of last season.

Sports.title: Mo Salah looks stunned as he’s offered very unusual gift by mayor after signing for Trabzonspor
Sports.content:
EGYPTIAN icon Mo Salah was left awkwardly scratching his beard after receiving an unconventional signing bonus from the mayor of his new Turkish home.

The Liverpool legend looked baffled after a promotional video for Trabzonspor took an unexpected political turn.



Many were stunned when 2024’s Premier League Player of the Season signed for Turkey‘s fourth biggest team on a free transfer.

But a new twist in Salah’s transfer saga has surprised even the superstar himself.



After 25,000 Trabzonspor fans overwhelmed Salah with flares and an electric show of support yesterday, the 34-year-old was greeted with an entirely different prospect on Friday morning.

Trazbon district mayor Huseyin Avni Coskun Cebi met Salah for a commercial shoot, but the local administrator suddenly began speaking to the marquee signing about the climate crisis.

Salah picked at his facial hair as mayor Cebi informed him: “Global warming is threatening the world.”

“In the future, it will become difficult to live in Egypt during the summer. Our district will be very liveable in those years. It will be among the places least affected by global warming.”

After advertising Trazbon’s eco credentials, Cebi followed up with an unprecedented gift to try and tempt Salah to stay in the city in long term.

In a gesture that seemed to shock Salah, the right winger was bestowed with a “beautiful piece of land” in the city.



SUN VEGAS WELCOME OFFER: GET UP TO £100 BONUS

Having expected promotional duties, Salah was instead given “a wonderful place for your children and grandchildren, with no water problems and unaffected by global warming.”

The latest offering comes on top of a £363,000 a week salary after tax at Trabzonspor.

Salah snubbed interest from the Saudi Pro League and Istanbul giants Bekistas before signing an eye-watering deal in the Black Sea city.

Sports.title: Jack Wilshere tells ex-Man Utd wonderkid to find a new club as Luton boss admits ‘he knows the situation’
Sports.content:
JACK WILSHERE has told former Manchester United defender Teden Mengi to find a new club before the end of the transfer window.

The Luton boss, 34, is preparing to kick off his first full season at the helm with a Carabao Cup trip to Gillingham tomorrow.



Mengi, 24, is fit and available to play after missing last season’s run-in with a hamstring injury.

But with the defender having fallen behind Hakeem Odoffin and new boy George Johnston in the pecking order, Wilshere reckons it would be best if he looked for a new club.



The ex-Arsenal midfielder said: “I spoke about Teds earlier on in pre-season.

“We brought in a centre-back, Hacks [Odoffin] came through last year. We still have Mads [Andersen], we still have Kal [Naismith], who can play there.



“So, yeah, while he’s [Mengi] here, of course, he’s training with us and there’s an opportunity for him.

“However, I think, and I’ve had these conversation with him as well, that it probably is best if he if he finds something else, but we’ll see on that.”

Wilshere went on to add: “I want to remain respectful to Teds because he’s someone I’ve got a massive respect for but, yeah, he knows the situation anyway. He’s training, but looking for something.”

Mengi signed for Luton from Man Utd ahead of their 2023-24 Premier League campaign.



BEST FREE BETS AND BETTING SIGN UP OFFERS

He featured 30 times for the Hatters in the Prem, but has suffered an injury-hit two seasons since.

The central defender is fit and training but has not featured in Luton’s pre-season friendlies.

Unlike several of his team-mates, however, he has retained his squad number, avoiding being totally frozen out.

Lasse Nordas, Jerry Yates, Reuell Walters and Tom Holmes, on the other hand, have all been left without squad numbers as the Hatters look to move them on.



Luton finished last season on an 11-game unbeaten run but agonisingly missed out on a play-off spot on the final day.

After tomorrow’s cup clash at Gillingham, Luton will get their League One campaign underway with a trip to Reading on August 15.

Sports.title: I took on Harry Kane to see how I’d stack up against a professional footballer – I beat England star in key test
Sports.content:
WE HAVE all wondered how we’d stack up against a professional footballer, so I put myself against the best.

After the best season of his life, Harry Kane is putting up numbers that we have only ever seen produced by the greatest to ever play the beautiful game – Lionel Messi.



So, to really compare myself against him, I’d need some physical numbers to shoot for, and some serious improvement on my finishing skills which would never match his…

Thankfully, with my StatSports vest on, which Kane himself uses to check out his numbers with best-in-the-game tracking and tech, I had all the numbers I needed, and the right equipment to track my progress.



CHALLENGE ONE: SPRINT SPEED

Now, obviously, Kane is a professional athlete.

I, on the other hand, play 5-a-side once a week, often skip leg day, and ate fast food almost every day while I was at the World Cup watching him hammer home the goals.



So to start off, I chose a test I thought I had a chance of beating him at – sprint speed.

During the World Cup, StatSports measured Harry Kane‘s top speed as 32.1kph, and they set me up with a 40m sprint to see how close I could get to that.

My first two attempts clocked in slower than him, at 31.1kph and then 30.2kph, before I finally pulled it together and got the better of him with my third sprint, at 32.3kph – I was buzzing with that.

BEST FREE BETS AND BETTING SIGN UP OFFERS



CANFIELD 1-0 KANE

CHALLENGE TWO: JUMPING

Something Kane is certainly better than me at though, is scoring headers.

A key part of which, is your ability to leap in the air, which is not one of my strengths.

A professional like the England number nine would be looking to measure up at around 40cm in my next test, a standing vertical jump, with the top five percent of Prem stars clocking in at over 48cm.



Up I stepped, all 5’7 of me, to jump a whopping 31cm – nine centimeters short of my target.

Kane had levelled the scoring, just like he did against DR Congo.

CANFIELD 1-1 KANE

CHALLENGE THREE: STAMINA

My stamina has occasionally left a little to be desired.



But after plenty of pavement miles in the last season or so, thanks to running every time Chelsea lost last season, and then in the altitude of Mexico City, which saw me labelled ‘pathetic’ by Piers Morgan and John Terry, I feel fairly fit at the moment.

To measure my stamina, the StatSports team had me run one kilometre as quickly as I could – running back and forth on a football pitch.

They reliably informed me that Kane would be aiming for a time of under three-and-a-half minutes, so that was my benchmark.

Off I went, with former professional footballer Sam Wardrop guiding me on my timings, who told me after my first length “you need to pick up the pace, way too f****** slow.”

That I did.



I was briefly on track to match him when my legs started giving up on me, and I was falling behind – still pushing my limits but unable to keep up with Bayern’s best.

The final sprint back to the line felt as though I had chains around my ankles with planets attached to them, as I clocked in at just under four minutes.

Still, I was pretty pleased that I could do 1km in under four minutes, but disappointed I had been beaten.

RECOMMENDED STORIES

So he had won, but I WILL be working on my dribbling and finishing to one day be better than him at those…

FINAL SCORE: CANFIELD 1-2 KANE

Sports.title: Newcastle’s £25.7m keeper Hornicek was wrestling carp while negotiating deal and vows to bring ‘sexy’ back to St James’
Sports.content:
HE’S Horni, Horni the new Geordie.

Fellow Czech goalie Pavel Srnicek achieved legendary status as part of Kevin Keegan’s Entertainers.



And £25.7m Lukas Hornicek wants to bring “sexy football” back to Newcastle.

Speaking to SunSport at the plush Hotel Grand Hyatt La Manga Club at Toon’s Spanish training camp, he said: “For sure, Pavel Srnicek made the first steps for me to be here in Newcastle, right? People in Newcastle know the Czech goalkeepers and they probably like them. So, this is also good.



“Yeah, I would like to bring the sexy football by winning the games and by making the fans happy.”

Hornicek, whose ‘Horni’ nickname from his old club will certainly stick with him, joined Newcastle from Portuguese club SC Braga on Monday.



The strapping 6ft 6in 24-year-old will debut for the Mags in Saturday night’s friendly against Valencia at the Mestalla – new boss Matthias Jaissle’s first game in charge.

Some supporters may even be fearing Hornicek looking like a fish out of water. Though he is more used to pulling them out himself.

In fact, he was even wrestling a carp as he fell hook, line and sinker for Newcastle during his very first phone call with Toon’s sporting director Ross Wilson.

Hornicek said: “It’s a funny story. I was fishing for two days in Portugal, because my girlfriend and daughter went to the Czech Republic for one of her exams. So, I was there alone and was like, ‘Okay, let’s go fishing’ to get my mind off of everything that was happening.



BEST FREE BETS AND BETTING SIGN UP OFFERS

“Then my agent called me and said, ‘Hey, there will be a call from Newcastle,’ so I picked it up and I was fishing at that moment.

“For 30 minutes of call everything goes smoothly, and then from nowhere, I got a [makes swishing sound] hit on my rod. Then, for another 20 minutes, I was fighting the carp as they kept talking to me. It was a funny moment.”



The North East’s three big rivers – Tyne, Wear and Tees – are famed for their salmon, trout and pike. Though you will not find the recent arrival hunting the predators down river banks. He much prefers to kick back by a lake.

He revealed: “Pike fishing is too much! You are reeling in and you need to find the fish. This is too demanding for me as a footballer.

“We are just exhausted, you know, after the [training] session. Carp fishing, you just throw it out, sit down, enjoy the view, and you just relax yourself.”

Hornicek will be desperate to ensure he will be Catch of the Day by keeping a clean sheet in the Prem opener against Liverpool on Sunday 23 August.



The spotlight of playing in the big time and moving to a whole new country also provide other obstacles.

But Hornicek left home for Portugal as a 17-year-old after being spotted by Braga playing at Pardubice and soon settled.

And the infectiously fun star has already netted two beauties off the pitch in long-term girlfriend Aneta Spilkova and adorable nine-month old daughter Mikela ‘Ella’ Marie.

He added: “She’s [baby] really sunshine, always so smiley. She would be smiling at all of you, dancing. She loves the song from the 2026 World Cup, the Shakira one. She’s always dancing and she’s really good.



“For sure, that [fatherhood] made me more mature. Before, I still had a girlfriend, of course, but she doesn’t make you more of a grown-up man.

“But when you get the baby, then you’re like, ‘Okay, now it’s serious’. You need to start thinking about your family. So, in these terms, I’m more evolved, like how are we spending money and thinking much more about the future.”

RECOMMENDED STORIES

For Newcastle, the future is now. A new manager and five exciting new additions to a squad that has lost stars Bruno Guimaraes, Sandro Tonali and Anthony Gordon.

Hornicek added: “I don’t think too much about it. Even though those players left, we have a great team.”

Sports.title: ITV World Cup commentator and former England star joins 17th club of his career weeks after tournament ends
Sports.content:
ANDROS TOWNSEND has swapped the World Cup commentary box for Thailand’s League 1.

25 days after taking the mic in the tournament’s quarter finals, the former England winger has joined the 17th club of his career.



However, PT Prachuap had already let slip about their marquee signing in unprecedented style 13 days before today’s official announcement.

The Thai team bemusingly took to Facebook to ask if anyone had a three-bedroom house by the sea for the former Spurs star.



Townsend is no stranger to the no frills nature of football in the South East Asian nation.

Last season, the 35-year-old had to dry himself with a sock after a post match shower at his former club Kanchanaburi Power.

The nomadic forward’s new team PT Prachuap were founded in 2009 as regional minnows, before breaking into the top flight nine years ago.

A sleepy seaside destination, Townsend’s latest home is known for its crescent-shaped bay and relaxed pace of life.

The 13-time England international was playing in the Premier League as recently as 2024, but has found Thailand to be ideally suited to his viral dietary preferences.

After his first Thai transfer last year, Townsend said he was thrilled that he could find chicken feet to snack on “as soon as I touched down”.



SUN VEGAS WELCOME OFFER: GET UP TO £100 BONUS

During his 11-match ITV commentary stint at this summer‘s World Cup, Townsend whipped social media into a frenzy by eating boiled eggs on a plane, as well as raw meat.

The player and broadcaster credits his recovery from a seemingly career-ending ACL injury in 2021 to a total rejection of processed foods.

Townsend once scored a 25-yard screamer for England in a World Cup qualifier, but had to endure nine loan spells across a journeyman career in his home country.

The Tottenham academy product also played 185 times for Crystal Palace, and was memorably shortlisted for the Puskas award after his stunning volley helped the Eagles upset Manchester City in 2018.

Sports.title: Ivan Toney shares snaps from luxury holiday days after being charged with nightclub assault
Sports.content:
IVAN TONEY has shared snaps of himself on holiday to his social media, just days after he was charged with assault.

It was announced by the Met Police on Friday that England World Cup star Toney had been charged with assault causing actual bodily harm following an alleged headbutt during a brawl inside a London nightclub.



Exclusive footage revealed by the 30-year-old was arrested at a trendy Soho bar and frogmarched out of the venue at 100 Wardour St on December 6, 2025.

The force confirmed Toney, who plays for Saudi side Al-Ahli, would be due to appear at Westminster Magistrates’ Court on September 24 – two days before England play Spain in a Nation’s League tie.



But days after the charge, and days before it was made public, Toney shared snaps of himself enjoying his summer break following the World Cup in North America.

Toney was seen posing with his arms folded while wearing a sleeveless black vest, shorts and a hat in front of a scenic city and ocean view background.



The former Brentford stars Instagram, where he has just under a million followers, showed him on spin bikes and with more bold fashion statements in a picturesque sunny setting.

In one short video Toney was seen grimacing as he stepped into a bath tub.

Another snap showed a stunning pool and property basking in sunlight, with the final pic seeing him looking sharp in a collared shirt.

He captioned the post: “Down time but we stay up.”



Issuing a statement, the force said: “A man has been charged with assault following a Met investigation.

“Ivan Toney, 30, of Northampton, was charged on Thursday, 31 July with assault causing actual bodily harm.

“He will appear at Westminster Magistrates’ Court on Thursday, 24 September.



“The charge relates to an assault, which reportedly took place on 6 December 2025 at a nightclub on Wardour Street, W1.”

Sports.title: FA announce changes after tragic death of ex-Arsenal footballer aged 21
Sports.content:
FA announce changes after tragic death of ex-Arsenal footballer aged 21

Former Arsenal youngster Billy Vigar suffered a significant brain injury back in September last year, with changes now being put in place by the Football Association

View 2 Images Billy Vigar passed away in September (Image: David Price/Arsenal FC via Getty Images)

The Football Association (FA) have announced that solid walls around the perimeter of pitches have been banned following the tragic death of Billy Vigar. The former Arsenal youth player died from a head injury after colliding with a wall last season.

The incident occurred with Vigar playing for Chichester City against Wingate & Finchley FC back in September. The 21-year-old collided with a concrete wall surrounding the pitch, resulting in a significant brain injury.

Vigar was part of Arsenal’s youth sides before moving to Hastings United in 2024. He signed with Chichester City last summer, a few months before his death.

The wall at Wingate & Finchley FC has now been removed, with the FA confirming a review of pitch surroundings for non-league grounds . The findings of the review have now been released.

It has been confirmed that the FA: "no longer permits solid brick, breeze block or concrete barriers around pitches across the National League system for men [steps 1-6], and the Women's National League [tiers 3-4]".

UEFA could boycott 5 tournaments in next 11 months after new Gianni Infantino statement READ MORE :

JOIN US ON FACEBOOK! Latest news, analysis and much more on Mirror Football's Facebook page

Article continues below

In a statement, the FA added: "Any existing solid brick, breeze block or concrete barriers must be removed as soon as reasonably practicable, or covered with suitable protection if they cannot be removed for structural reasons. We have informed the clubs at this level that will be required to take action as a result of these changes.

"Matches may continue to be played at affected grounds during this period; however, clubs should assess the safety of their pitch perimeter barriers on an ongoing basis, and where alterations to these structures have been recommended during this review, they should develop a plan to complete any such alterations within a reasonable timeframe."

Non-league clubs will be helped with funding the changes with the money coming from both the FA and the Premier League. The Press Association reports that 160 of the 900 clubs who play at the levels have been contacted over changes that will have to be made to their stadiums.

View 2 Images The FA have announced changes following the youngster's tragic death (Image: Getty Images)

The FA added: "The initial phase of the programme is already underway, and we will continue to provide full support to the clubs involved in this process.”

Following the announcement, a PFA spokesperson said: “Following the tragic death of Billy Vigar last year, we again highlighted these concerns and made clear our view that the lack of progress and leadership on this issue had been unacceptable.

"As part of working groups set up by the FA following Billy's death, we pushed for the FA's Stadium Accreditation criteria to be amended to ban these types of walls so that there is a clear and centralised policy for clubs to follow.

"Given that, it's a welcome step that the FA's regulations have now been changed to reflect that position.

"However, it will now be important for progress on the removal of such walls - and effective mitigation of risks ahead of their removal - to be properly monitored, and for clubs to be given the support they need so that these changes can happen as soon as possible. Player safety must always come first."

Sports.title: Arsenal could break unwanted transfer record as Mikel Arteta green lights two deals
Sports.content:
Arsenal could break unwanted transfer record as Mikel Arteta green lights two deals

Arsenal are still chasing a blockbuster signing in the summer transfer window and Mikel Arteta's side need to lay the groundwork first by making space in the squad

View 2 Images Mikel Arteta knows that sales are needed this summer (Image: Stuart MacFarlane/Arsenal FC via Getty Images)

Arsenal could finally eclipse their record sale with Gabriel Martinelli attracting interest from Turkey. The Gunners' focus recently has been on Bruno Guimaraes and Vinicius Junior, but exits are also in the pipeline.

‌



Guimaraes is poised to join Mikel Arteta's side for £75million after a compromise was reached with Newcastle. But the pursuit of Vinicius has ended in defeat, with the Brazilian forward set to sign a new contract with Real Madrid.

‌



Arsenal will now turn their attention to other targets as they chase a blockbuster deal, and while the identity of their alternative signing is not yet known, the groundwork is being laid. Leandro Trossard (Besiktas), Jakub Kiwior (Porto), Karl Hein (Werder Bremen) and Christian Norgaard (Everton) are currently the only players to leave and bring in transfer fees this summer.

‌



It is something that sporting director Andrea Berta knows he must address, especially if a world-class forward like Julian Alvarez and a centre-back to cover for the injured William Saliba is to arrive before the deadline passes on September 1.

FOLLOW OUR ARSENAL FB PAGE! Latest Gunners news and more on our dedicated Facebook page

Liverpool's firm stance on Djed Spence transfer as Reds battle defensive injury crisis READ MORE :

Martinelli has entered the final year of his contract with Arsenal, posing the possibility of his exit, over seven years after he joined the club. The 25-year-old has 62 goals in 278 appearances for the club since his £6million move in 2019, but his time may have come.

‌



Arsenal are reportedly considering a sale to Galatasaray, who are interested in landing the Brazil international. And were a move to come to fruition it could see Martinelli become Arsenal's record sale, with the £35m earned for Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain's move to Liverpool in 2019 surprisingly still the high-water mark for the club.

Their inability to sell well has become an issue for Arsenal, who have often seen their rivals out-perform them. Trossard pulled in £17m from Besiktas, while Norgaard earned just £7m from Everton. If Arsenal are to achieve their goals in terms of incomings then Martinelli and Gabriel Jesus could become facilitators.

View 2 Images Gabriel Martinelli and Gabriel Jesus could both be sold (Image: Stuart MacFarlane/Arsenal FC via Getty Images)

‌



Jesus has become a fringe player at Arsenal, with Viktor Gyokeres and Kai Havertz ahead of him in the pecking order and is attracting interest from Napoli and AC Milan. The 29-year-old's contract expires in June 2027, meaning this window is Arsenal's last realistic chance to earn a decent fee.

Arsenal are understood to be seeking a fee in the region of the £17m they got for Trossard, but as time ticks by in August they could be forced to compromise.

Arteta knows that Arsenal must strengthen their squad this summer if they are to stand any chance of defending their Premier League title in 2026/27. "We are really active, trying to improve and evolve the team. That's clear," he said in a post-match press conference after facing Girona on the weekend.

Article continues below

"We expect to have movements in the next few weeks, obviously, because we want to get better like anybody else. And you can just see it. The transfer market and our opponents, what we are doing, we won't sit still. And we are very ambitious in what we want to do."

Sports.title: Enzo Maresca wants Chelsea star to replace Rodri as Barcelona move advances
Sports.content:
Enzo Maresca wants Chelsea star to replace Rodri as Barcelona move advances

Barcelona have seen an opening bid for Manchester City midfielder Rodi turned down on Friday - but the La Liga giants are expected to return as they close in on the World Cup winner

View 3 Images Barcelona have launched an opening offer for Man City midfielder Rodri

Enzo Maresca has earmarked Chelsea midfielder Enzo Fernandez as his top option to replace Rodri this summer.

‌



Barcelona have seen an opening offer of £38.5million rejected out of hand by City, who want closer to £60m. However, with just one year remaining on his contract and coming off a serious knee injury, City are open to selling at the right price.

‌



And Maresca, who is going into his first season as Pep Guardiola ’s replacement, sees Fernandez as the perfect replacement for the World Cup Golden Ball winner.

‌



The Italian worked with Fernandez during his time as Chelsea boss and according to the Independent, City are already exploring a possible move for the Argentinian.

Inside Bruno Guimaraes' dream Arsenal transfer six years in making for Mikel Arteta READ MORE :

Fernandez is yet to report for Chelsea this summer after playing a huge role in Argentina’s rollercoaster ride to the World Cup final. The 25-year-old scored crucial goals in the knockout stages, including a screamer in the dramatic comeback against England in the semis.

However, he arguably cost his nation the chance of lifting a fourth world title after he inexplicably picked up two yellow cards in a matter of minutes.

‌



Chelsea paid £106m for the midfielder in 2023 and would want to make a profit on that, if they were to entertain an exit this summer.

Fernandez was sanctioned earlier this year after his desire to leave the London club was made public. Ex-boss Liam Rosenior was also forced to strip him of the vice captaincy before he was sacked for a disastrous run of results.

View 3 Images Chelsea want a reported £120m for Enzo Fernandez (Image: Visionhaus/Getty Images)

‌



New Blues boss Xabi Alonso hasn’t been able to train with the talismanic midfielder during his short tenure, but made it clear he wants him to remain at the club.

Speaking in July, Alonso said: "Yes we have spoken. But as you can imagine what we have spoken remains private,” and then when pressed if he wanted Fernandez to stay, he replied “yes”.

City have already smashed their own transfer record this summer, signing Elliot Anderson from Nottingham Forest for a whopping £116m. But with the exit of Bernardo Silva and the expected one of Rodri, more cover is required before the Premier League campaign begins.

‌



They have also been heavily linked with Ayyoub Bouaddi from Lille, who shone at the World Cup with Morocco, but his £86m valuation has led talks to an impasse.

View 3 Images Enzo Maresca worked with Fernandez during his time as Chelsea boss

Speaking after City’s most recent pre-season friendly, Maresca admitted the club still had work to do in order to replace a number of senior players.

‌



“Fortunately this is a squad that doesn’t need to do many things,” he told media at a press conference ahead of Wednesday’s clash with K-League All Stars.

“At the same time, we already know the squad lost some important players with experience with Bernardo, John [Stones], Nathan [Ake]…different players. For sure, there are things we need to do.

He added: “The reason I said there are things to do is because the transfer window is open and when it is open, anything can happen. It is August and then from September, when it’s closed, it is completely different.”

Sports.title: Arsenal star's gesture to Bruno Guimaraes ahead of £75m transfer comes to light
Sports.content:
Arsenal star's gesture to Bruno Guimaraes ahead of £75m transfer comes to light

Arsenal are preparing to confirm the £75m signing of Bruno Guimaraes after the soon-to-be former Newcastle captain completed his medical - and his shirt number seemingly been leaked

View 2 Images Bruno Guimaraes will join Arsenal for £75million (Image: Mark Leech/Offside/Offside via Getty Images)

Bruno Guimaraes is set to wear the No.39 shirt for Arsenal after academy star Louie Copley moved to a new number. Arsenal are preparing to confirm Guimaraes' arrival from Newcastle after the two clubs agreed a fixed fee of £75million to end the transfer saga.

‌



The 28-year-old said his goodbyes at Newcastle's training camp in Spain before completing his medical with Arsenal and signing a four-year contract. His signing still hasn't been announced, although the Gunners have dropped a clear hint on their website.

‌



Copley, who wore the No. 39 shirt in each of Arsenal's first two pre-season friendlies as well as in training sessions, has had his squad number changed to 38. It's a telltale sign that Guimaraes is now a Gunner and has taken his favourite number.

‌



The midfielder has worn 39 throughout his club career, including for former clubs Lyon and Athletico Paranaense. Guimaraes likes to wear the number because his dad's taxi cab in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil was #039.

FOLLOW OUR ARSENAL FB PAGE! Latest Gunners news and more on our dedicated Facebook page

Inside Bruno Guimaraes' dream Arsenal transfer six years in making for Mikel Arteta READ MORE :

Tottenham respond as Arsenal consider shock transfer for Spurs skipper Cristian Romero READ MORE :

Whether the decision was Copley's is unknown, although he did wear No.38 when captaining Arsenal's under-21 side last season. Unfortunately for Copley, who's just 19 and highly regarded at London Colney, he suffered an injury just minutes after coming on as a half-time substitute during the Gunners' 3-1 loss against Real Betis in a friendly on Wednesday.

‌



Mikel Arteta said post-match: "It doesn't look good, the mechanism is not too positive, the symptoms that he already has either. Let's hope that tomorrow [Thursday] the news is better than we hope."

Guimaraes will become Arsenal's most expensive signing of the summer, with the Gunners having also brought in Christos Tzolis for £34m and Illan Meslier on a free transfer. The Brazilian is expected to partner Declan Rice in midfield once the season gets going.

Who should Arsenal sign next? Have your say in the comments section.

‌

"He's a fantastic player and a great human being. It's tough but for him now it's the next challenge and we need to deal with it at a later stage. We trust the players who are here already, but we will also see some changes."

Sports.title: Terror plot to 'storm World Cup game with bombs and kill Lionel Messi' uncovered
Sports.content:
Terror plot to 'storm World Cup game with bombs and kill Lionel Messi' uncovered

FBI and IPCC logs show Lionel Messi received the most threats during the World Cup, including a disturbing incident where a man claimed he would carry guns and bombs to a game

View 2 Images Messi received the most threats during the World Cup (Image: DiaEsportivo/Action Plus/Shutterstock)

Terrorists planned to attack Lionel Messi by storming a World Cup match with guns and bombs, a police report states.

‌



A catalogue of threats were made during the tournament, held in the US, including from a man who was arrested trying to get into a lift with Cristiano Ronaldo.

‌



Reports from the International Police Cooperation Center (IPCC) and FBI also show the referee of the Argentina-Egypt match, Francois Letezier, was targeted with more than 6,000 threats on his personal WhatsApp - and his family back in France received police protection. The security reports have been revealed by Spanish newspaper Informacion.es.

‌



The reports note how one man wrote on X ahead of the Argentina clash with Egypt on July 7: "I'm going to walk into the Atlanta stadium and blow up Messi with four bombs stuck in my body."

View 2 Images There were many reports of Cristiano Ronaldo being harassed (Image: AP Photo/Tony Gutierrez)

Aldi and Lidl could soon be stopped from blocking rival supermarkets opening shops READ MORE :

The most concrete threat against Messi arose when a man called Dallas airport and announced that he and two other individuals were heading to the city's stadium with "homemade bombs and an AR-15".

‌



In his message, he stated that they intended to attack "police officers and players from both teams" but the alleged terrorist made "special mention of Lionel Messi".

Several explosives specialists, canine handlers and their K-9 agents searched the Atlanta stadium after another man called police during the game and announced he had left "three bombs" in litter bins in the stadium.

According to the dossier, Messi received the most threats while Ronaldo was the most harassed while during the competition.

‌



On June 14, a FIFA employee reported "a suspicious man" who was asking for "details" about Ronaldo's accommodation at his hotel. Houston police identified and arrested that man two days later when he was at the hotel where Ronaldo was staying with his national team.

Another man was arrested in Toronto for a very similar incident when Ronaldo was there. This time, the supporter tried to get into the elevator with the Portuguese star when he was arrested. He said he just wanted to take a selfie with CR7.

Other incidents with Ronaldo occurred in Miami, when a man tried to gain access to him, and during the Portugal-Croatia match, when a man dressed in a Ronaldo shirt jumped onto the field.

Article continues below

Another of the many players singled out with threats was Kylian Mbappé, who had an ongoing argument with Paraguay's goalkeeper during the clash with France.

The police report said the Real Madrid player was insulted with "xenophobic" abuse online, while a doll with Mbappé's image "was burned and broadcast" on social networks in Paraguay on July 5 and 6.

Sports.title: Man Utd legend's blazing row with staff at local tip – 'I'm banned now'
Sports.content:
Man Utd legend's blazing row with staff at local tip – 'I'm banned now'

Former Manchester United midfielder Nicky Butt was left fuming when he was stopped from entering his local tip in his Range Rover

View 2 Images Nicky Butt has addressed the incident that led to him being banned from his local recycling centre

Nicky Butt has been kicked out of his local tip after a 'raging row' with workers. Butt, one of the Class of 92, blew his top when staff branded his Range Rover a commercial vehicle because the seats were folded flat. He dumped his 'smelling bags' anyway, prompting an employee to sprint after him.

‌



According to The Sun, Butt said: "There's this guy at the gate bit, and he flags me down and goes, 'Put your windows down I need to look in the back of your car'. I'm going, 'What for?'

‌



"I've got a lot of crap from the house, bit of cardboard... I missed the bin man last week, so I've got a few smelly bags.

‌



OPINION Man Utd dream attack as Marcus Rashford exits plus free agent striker and World Cup star join by Abbie Meehan

Michael Carrick's telling response after being told to sell eight players by Man Utd hero READ MORE :

"So I put the windows down, obviously my seats were down and apparently I'm not going in because it's a commercial van.

"So I'm raging, literally. I'm putting a bit of cardboard in the tip."

‌



Butt also claimed he was told he was 'sneaking' rubbish into the tip due to the blacked out windows on his Range Rover.

He added: "I thought, well, I'm there now, I'm gonna go for it. So I've got up the ramp, I see this bloke getting up...

"Trying to chase me up the hill, but he's got his walkie-talkie out.

‌



View 2 Images Nicky Butt was a key member of Sir Alex Ferguson's squad that won the Treble in 1999 (Image: Mirrorpix)

FOLLOW OUR MAN UTD FB PAGE! Latest United news and more on our dedicated Facebook page

"So I've literally got up the top, throw all the bags out, and I'm going back down the hill, and he's going mad at me.

‌



"Anyway, I'm banned from the tip."

A spokesperson for Recycle for Greater Manchester has since spoken out and said: “We’re sorry to hear about Nicky’s experience, but would like to reassure him that he is still very welcome to use any of the 19 Recycle for Greater Manchester recycling centres across the region.”

Butt was a vital cog in the United machine throughout the 1990s, collecting six Premier League titles, three FA Cups and the Champions League before his switch to Newcastle in 2004.

‌



He remained at St James' Park for another six years, which included a loan spell at Birmingham City, before calling time on his playing career following a stint in China.

Since retiring, he has taken on various positions at United and owned a share in Salford City, where he served as CEO between 2022 and 2024.

Sports.title: Rodri's agent drops transfer bombshell as Man City star decides future
Sports.content:
Rodri's agent drops transfer bombshell as Man City star decides future

Real Madrid were long considered the favourites to sign Rodri before Barcelona entered the running, with the midfielder having entered the final 12 months of his contract at Manchester City

View 2 Images Rodri has decided his next club (Image: Carl Recine/Getty Images)

Rodri's agent has announced that the Manchester City star wants to join Barcelona over arch rivals Real Madrid. Rodri, 30, agreed personal terms with Barca on Thursday in a sudden and dramatic twist.

The Spaniard had been in talks with Real for weeks after suggesting back in March that he was keen on a move to the Bernabeu. But Barcelona have hijacked the move after Rodri spoke to their manager, Hansi Flick, and sporting director Deco and was convinced to join the La Liga champions.

Although City haven't given up hope of tying Rodri down to a new contract after he entered the final year of his current deal, Etihad chiefs are well aware of his desire to return to Spain. In a late-night interview with Cadena SER, Rodri's agent, Pablo Barquero, revealed all.

‌



"Out of respect for Madrid, as they have been class, Rodri informed them that his decision is to join Barca," Barquero told the Spanish radio station.

FOLLOW OUR MAN CITY FB PAGE! Follow our Manchester City Mirror Football Facebook page

Ex-Man City captain gives health update after being diagnosed with devastating rare condition READ MORE :

Barcelona are in the market for a midfielder after Frenkie de Jong was ruled out for several months. Rodri is seen as a plug and play option, having gotten over his injury troubles and helped Spain win the World Cup last month.

The 30-year-old also picked up the Golden Ball at the tournament, playing an integral role for Luis de la Fuente's side. His departure from City would follow that of manager Pep Guardiola, defender John Stones and midfielder Bernardo Silva in a summer of change at the Etihad.

New boss Enzo Maresca remains desperate to keep him, though, and stated earlier this week: "It's very important (to have him). Any manager in the world wants Rodri because he's a top player; so it's important for me, the club and for everyone."

Should Manchester City sell Rodri? Have your say in the comments section.

‌



View 2 Images Rodri was named Player of the Tournament at the World Cup (Image: Carl Recine/Getty Images)

But Maresca's hopes could soon be dashed. Barcelona have room in their wage budget following the departure of Robert Lewandowski and appear to have enough funds to tempt City to the negotiating table, having bid around £100m for Atletico Madrid forward Julian Alvarez in June.

Rodri has spent seven years with City, winning four Premier League titles, one Champions League and two FA Cups. The former ex-Villarreal man received the Ballon d'Or in 2024, having won that year's European Championship with Spain.

Sports.title: Liverpool news: Bradley Barcola price tag slashed as star 'says yes' to PSG transfer
Sports.content:
Liverpool news: Bradley Barcola price tag slashed as star 'says yes' to PSG transfer

The Reds have been quoted a new price tag for Bradley Barcola as the club's transfer activity heats up

View 3 Images Bradley Barcola is significantly valued by PSG (Image: Rob Newell - CameraSport, CameraSport via Getty Images)

Liverpool will be eager to ramp up their transfer business as the new Premier League season edges closer. The Reds will face Monaco in a friendly at Anfield this weekend, having recently completed a pre-season tour of the USA.

‌



The Anfield outfit finally welcomed new signing Victor Munoz to the club this week, after he signed from Osasuna earlier in the summer. The Spanish winger and French centre-back Jeremy Jacquet are the only new faces at the Reds so far this pre-season, with Liverpool in need of more reinforcements.

‌



Much has been made of the club's chase of Paris Saint-Germain winger Bradley Barcola, with the European champions said to be demanding a huge fee from the Reds. Today's news sees PSG's latest stance on Barcola's price tag emerge, while a World Cup star reportedly agrees to a move to Paris.

‌



PSG set Bradley Barcola terms

PSG are reportedly insisting on raking in a staggering £128million for Barcola this summer, according to L'Equipe. The substantial price tag is believed to be the reason a transfer to Liverpool has failed to materialise so far, but it is less than the initial £145m that the French side were originally quoted as wanting for the player.

FOLLOW OUR LIVERPOOL FB PAGE! Latest Reds news and more on our dedicated Facebook page

Jamie Carragher criticises Mohamed Salah's Turkey move after Liverpool exit READ MORE :

Liverpool exploring Ibrahim Mbaye transfer as PSG star's stance on move emerges READ MORE :

It's believed that the Reds would prefer to pay around £103m for the winger with Barcola said to be open to the move. The BBC say Liverpool are preparing to change their stance and up their offer to get the deal over the line, while L'Equipe says that, while the two clubs are "very far apart", the transfer is expected to be sealed before the window closes.

‌



The fee for Barcola has some concerned. Ex-Anfield star Michael Owen believes the Reds will have to be realistic when it comes to shelling out such cash for the French winger.

View 3 Images Liverpool's interest in Bradley Barcola remains strong (Image: Getty Images)

Owen told the ECHO, via Casino.org: "Barcola, he's obviously the big name on everybody's lips. It sounds like he might be available. It sounds like he's going to be expensive, though - but they're going to have to make some form of statement signing, of course. You know, it used to be Salah, and [Sadio] Mane and [Luis] Diaz.

"Obviously [Barcola has] played at the highest level, but, yeah, at some point you've got to say no, haven't you? If it gets to £145m, wow, that's eye-watering."

Ferran Torres 'says yes' to transfer

Barcelona star Ferran Torres has reportedly agreed to join PSG this summer in a move that could grease the wheels for Barcola to join Liverpool. The Spanish World Cup winner is said to be mulling over his future while on holiday after his exploits at the tournament this summer.

‌



That decision has been made according to Spanish outlet Sport, with Torres giving the green light to PSG boss Luis Enrique for a switch. The forward has made no secret of his openness to leaving Barca in recent interviews.

"In the world of football, you never know," Torres said when questioned about a possible departure from the Catalan giants this summer.

View 3 Images Ferran Torres netted the winner in the World Cup final (Image: FRANCK FIFE / AFP via Getty Images)

‌



In July, Sport reported that Enrique himself intervened to bring the former Manchester City star to Paris. Barcelona have stated they would sell for a generous offer but are happy to keep the forward this summer.

PSG are now set to make an offer for Torres' transfer, with the desire to finalise a move before the Spanish international's return next week following the World Cup. The capture of Torres would represent another building block as PSG look to restructure their attack this summer.

Monaco winger Maghnes Akliouche is reportedly close to joining while they are also working on a deal to sign Mika Godts, the Belgian forward from Ajax. If those deals go through, it could potentially lay the groundwork for Barcola to depart for the Reds and put to bed the long-running transfer saga.

Sports.title: Flintoff steps down as England Lions head coach
Sports.content:
Andrew Flintoff has stepped down as head coach of the England Lions.

Flintoff began in the role in September 2024, meaning he leaves just under two years in.

In June it was announced Flintoff would become head coach of Sydney Thunder in Australia's Big Bash League.

On the decision, Flintoff said: "Unfortunately I've made the decision to step away from my role with the Lions. Not only have I enjoyed my time having the opportunity to work with the best young cricketers in the country, but have taken great pride in seeing them develop.

Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Relive the top highlights from Andrew Flintoff's seven-game stint with Brisbane Heat in 2014/15.

"I'd like to thank the coaches and staff for all their passion, tireless work and support they give every day. In particular, Ed Barney who I've loved working with and was so lucky to have as a performance director, and obviously Rob (Key) for trusting me with one of the most important roles in English cricket.

"I can't wait to get started with the Thunder later in the year and see where coaching takes me."

Ed Barney, ECB men's performance director, said: "Fred has helped to transform the Lions environment into a programme that has had a major impact on young players. By creating an environment that both supports and pushes excellence at all times he has helped bring forward a new generation of young players.

"Coaches have also flourished alongside him, whether early in their coaching journey or with decades of experience, and he has consistently maximised the expertise around the group. We wish him the best in the next stage of his coaching career and look forward to a time he returns to the English game."

Mike Yardy will step in as head coach for the four-day Professional County Club Select XI match against Pakistan Men, which begins at Beckenham on Wednesday August 12.

Barcola is not the only PSG winger Liverpool are interested in, with Andoni Iraola's side having explored the conditions of a deal for Ibrahim Mbaye.

The 18-year-old, who predominantly plays off the right, is believed to be interested in moving to Anfield.

Their interest in the teenager is completely independent of any potential move for Barcola, who has been on Liverpool's radar for a number of years.

It is possible that Liverpool could sign Mbaye and another more experienced option.

Liverpool are planning to have five wingers at the end of the window, with an additional one being a younger player they want to develop.

Liverpool move appeals to Barcola

Image: Barcola has two years left on his PSG contract

Iraola sees his wide men as being key to his philosophy, which is why this area of the squad is the big focus in his first window on Merseyside, especially after the exit of Mohamed Salah.

Barcola has two years left on his PSG contract and has indicated he will not be signing a new one amid frustrations at a lack of game time.

The opportunity to join Liverpool is said to appeal to the France international.

The key to getting any deal moving will be PSG's willingness to reduce the price tag on the man they bought for around £40m from Lyon in the summer of 2023.

The success of Iraola's teams at Bournemouth and Rayo Vallecano centred around the pace, energy and work-rate from his wingers, so Barcola could be a key piece of the Spaniard's new Liverpool jigsaw.

The fact that Barcola has won nine major trophies in the last two years, including two Champions League titles, shows the calibre of player they are trying to bring to Anfield.

Arsenal, who missed out on signing Vinicius Junior following his Real Madrid contract extension, also hold an interest in Barcola.

Sports.title: White: I know where the Fury-AJ venue is - I did the deal!
Sports.content:
The long-awaited heavyweight showdown between Tyson Fury and Anthony Joshua will take place "where the money is", says Dana White.

White, who founded the UFC and new promotion Zuffa Boxing, is a major figure in combat sports. He revealed that he knows where Fury vs Joshua will take place.

"We're the ones that have done all the deals for this fight. I did the deal for the venue, that's why I know where the venue is. I did the deal. We at TKO [the company which owns UFC, WWE and Zuffa Boxing] did the deal for television and we did everything," White told Sky Sports.

"It's just been such a [mess]. It's unbelievable what a [mess] this thing has been," White said.

"It goes to show why boxing has been so [messed] up for so long. Look at this. It's definitely not about the money. The Saudis are paying for this fight. So they're making [a lot] of money. Fury was a guest at White's UFC event at the White House and the promoter has known both fighters from before he launched his own boxing business.

"I've talked about Anthony Joshua after he beat (Wladimir) Klitschko and I was like that's what boxing needs, good looking, charismatic, good speaking heavyweight champion. So I've always really liked Anthony Joshua," White said.

"There was a point in time where Tyson was stagnant and trying to get fights so he started talking [trash] about UFC fighters, trying to get a payday one way or another and that was around the time that I met him and I've always liked him.

Sports.title: Middlesbrough v Wrexham: Carabao Cup first round – live
Sports.content:
Right wing-back Daniel Imray makes his full debut for Wrexham after moving from West Brom and Danny Ward gets the nod in goal.

Will Lankshear , a £10m buy from Spurs, makes his competitive debut for Boro up front. Their two American signings, Max Arfsten and Sebastian Berhalter , start as well.

For now the competition is split into north and south sections, as will be the case in round two, when the 11 Premier League sides not involved in Europe (including Chelsea, Tottenham, Everton and Newcastle) will enter. Round two is back to midweek on 25-27 August.

Hello and welcome to the start of the English football season. Well, technically that was yesterday with Walsall beating Bristol City in the opening game of the Carabao Cup proper – there was a preliminary round last weekend. But tonight there are three first-round ties and I’ll be focusing on the one at the Riverside as Middlesbrough host Wrexham.

The start of the EFL season has been spread out to allow players to have more rest between their first few matches, hence why a full round of Carabao Cup fixtures are being played over the course of the weekend for the first time this century.

Middlesbrough would have been hoping to avoid this round when they faced Hull in the Championship playoff final at the end of May, but their return to the big time has not happened just yet. Wrexham have been in the big time this summer, touring the United States, as they have in previous years, off the back of the success of their documentary series and the influence of their Hollywood owners.
